title: Gates and filing: a misclassified gate does not stop a worker, and a refused repro is refused when filed
goal: A worker whose gate the class rule makes blocking finishes on its recommendation and the landing waits for the operator's answer; a gate naming a token-count constant or a phase token is not classed secrets; new and set refuse a repro or check that backlog check refuses (a refused program, an unclosed quote) with exit 2 and nothing written; gate add --do takes an option whose text holds '='
